keyPoints: HistoryApiStorage is the only storage backend actually used by any section today — the GitHub- and Blob-Storage-backed classes (github_storage.py, blob_storage.py) are dead code, referenced only by their own tests
Private sections enforce per-item read access: only the item's author can view it; wrong-owner requests return 404 instead of 403
Private sections require authentication for all operations, including reads, aligning with ownership-based visibility rules
Legacy items without stamped author_email remain accessible to any allowlisted writer, ensuring backward compatibility
HistoryApiStorage backend enables version-history operations, including optimistic concurrency checks for create, update, and delete
architecture.overview: Azure Functions v2 app (Python) deployed to a Consumption plan. Each HTTP trigger handles one REST operation. Content is organized into named sections, each with its own schema and visibility rules. Both current sections — writing and diary — use HistoryApiStorage exclusively: every get/list/create/update/delete call is an HTTP request to [[posts-api|history-api]], which is now the sole storage backend, not an optional add-on. The repo also still contains GitHub- and Blob-Storage-backed storage classes from before the history-api migration; neither is wired into any current section and both are exercised only by their own unit tests. Auth uses google-auth to validate Google ID tokens server-side; no session state is maintained. Private sections enforce authentication and ownership checks for all operations, including reads.

dataFlow.label: Ownership / allowlist check
sublines: POST: email must be in ALLOWED_WRITERS
PUT/DELETE: requester must match author_email (or be in allowlist for legacy items)
Private sections require allowlist membership for all operations, including reads
Private-section reads: requester must match author_email; wrong-owner requests return 404

dataFlow.label: Version-history operations
sublines: GET /versions: mirrors get_item visibility rules (private sections require auth + allowlist + author match)
GET /versions/{version_id}: retrieves a specific version of an item
GET /versions/{v1}/diff/{v2}: computes a diff between two versions of an item

description: A serverless write API for quixotry.me's content sections. Both current sections (writing, diary) store their content as history-api documents — every read and write is an HTTP call to history-api, not a GitHub commit. A GitHub-backed storage class and a Blob Storage-backed one still exist in the repo but are unused dead code. The service now integrates with Application Insights for backend telemetry, enabling automatic tracking of HTTP request metrics (route, method, status, duration, exceptions) without requiring code changes.

Authentication is handled via Google ID tokens; content ownership is enforced per-creator, with an allowlist controlling who can write. Now includes Application Insights for backend telemetry.
